verdict.rationale: Lithic documents Card and Account Spend Limits for managing spend velocity (lithic-docs-13). Its Authorization Rules engine applies platform-side logic at the card, account, or program level 'without managing additional infrastructure' (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-17), and its own material describes configuring rules for transaction limits and velocity (lithic-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of daily/monthly/all-time window options, explicit transaction-count velocity rules, confirmation that account-level limits map to per-cardholder limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
